Subject: Service account attestation + SCIM delta export for SOC 2

Hi Ava,

As part of Clearlake Health's upcoming SOC 2 readiness review, our auditor has asked us to collect two pieces from Redwood: (1) an attestation that service accounts and non-human principals follow least-privilege policies and (2) a SCIM / provisioning delta export covering the period 2025-07-01 to 2025-08-15 showing changes to accounts, group membership, and service principals.

Can your team provide a short attestation (PDF or signed doc) that outlines the controls/process owners and a CSV export (SCIM delta) trimmed to the audit window? We need an initial packet by 2025-08-22 COB PST to stay on our review timeline.

Attached is the auditor intake form (SOC2_request_form.pdf) with the exact fields they're tracking. If anything in scope is a problem, call that out and propose a mitigator.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Wu
Security Manager, Clearlake Health
alice.wu@clearlake.com

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the deadline. We'll put together an attestation and a scoped SCIM delta export for the requested window.

High-level plan (quick):
- Attestation doc: short PDF describing our service account policy, owners (IAM team + infra), and recent role/privelege review cadence. Expect draft by 2025-08-20 EOD PST.
- SCIM delta export: we'll extract the provisioning delta (accounts, group membership, service principals) for 2025-07-01 -> 2025-08-15 and deliver as CSV. We'll also include a checklist mapping the CSV columns to the auditor intake fields.
- Workback: I'll create a JIRA ticket and upload a workback plan to a shared Drive. Link below.

Questions for scope confirmation:
1) Do you want service accounts separated from machine/service principals in the CSV, or is a single delta file sufficient?
2) Will the auditor accept a signed electronic attestation (PDF with digital signature) or do you need DocuSign?

Tentative owners: Kimberly will own the attestation text; Marcus will run the SCIM delta and sanity-check the CSV. I'll coordinate and deliver the packet to you.
